acceptance: update_item with an empty string clears a non-empty optional text field and records an update operation; a test covers it.
A request that changes nothing still returns E_STATE.
context:
Tracked in the todo-db tracker as update-item-clear-context (copied 2026-10-28).

RESOLVED 2026-10-29: BenchBox runs todo-db 0.11.0 (BenchBox-dev/benchbox#3725, merge a554c997f; release https://github.com/joeharris76/todo-db/releases/tag/v0.11.0). Criterion 1: an empty string clears context and description and records an update (test_empty_string_clears_context_and_description_and_is_recorded). Criterion 2: an update that supplies no field is still refused with E_STATE (test_an_update_that_supplies_no_field_is_refused). Note: an update whose values equal the stored ones is accepted, because it records a session entry (todo-db#52).
description: `update_item` with `context` set to an empty value on an item whose context is non-empty returns `E_STATE` `operation produced no state change`, so the field cannot be cleared. Observed 2026-10-21 on `oracle-local-b6-drop-in-repo-engine` (context set by mistake; restoring it to empty was refused). That item has since been dropped. Seen for `context`; other optional text fields untested.
